obligations.behavior: Initialize per-set Tree-PLRU state, advance PLRU on both lookup hits and line fills across all 4 ways, and forward same-set hit/fill updates cleanly to consecutive victim reads.

Integrate u_tag_sram with expanded 64-bit way bit-masks and mutually exclusive WEN/REN, preserve sibling valid sectors on sector refills, and forward same-set fills and non-LLC AMO hit invalidations cleanly.

Address u_data_slice_0..3 via folded {way, line_idx}, expand 8-bit byte masks to 64-bit A_BM, restrict fills/writes to target sector/word slices, and gate single-word reads to at most 1 active slice per bank.

Place all 10 SRAM macros legally inside core bounds, constrain clk <= 17.0 ns with >= 1.5 ns I/O delays, and close OpenROAD PDN, post-GRT WNS/hold >= 0.0 ns, overflow <= 25, and wirelength <= 6,200,000 um.
